Fuller, Smith & Turner PLC (FSTA)
Fuller, Smith & Turner PLC: Director / PDMR Shareholding

24-Jul-2026 / 16:50 GMT/BST

 Fuller, Smith & Turner P.L.C. (“the Company”)

Director / PDMR Shareholding

 

 

The Company has been notified of the transfer of 473 “A” Ordinary Shares of 40p each, 500,000 “B” Ordinary Shares of 4p each and 100,000 “C” Ordinary Shares of 40p each to Peter Turner, Property Director, from the estate of Catherine Mary Turner, deceased, a person closely connected to him, on 23 July 2026.

 

Further information is detailed in the following PDMR dealing notification.

 

This announcement is made in accordance with Article 19 of the EU Market Abuse Regulation 596/2014 (as incorporated into UK domestic law by the European Union (Withdrawal) Act 2018).
